name: Unfog
subtitle: Ride or walk the streets you haven't.

apps.name: Unfog
apps.subtitle: Ride or walk the streets you haven't.
apps.localizedDescription: Turn-by-turn bike and walking routes down streets you haven't covered yet, with directions that sound like a person. Offline street data for the Northeast Regional cities, Capital Bikeshare and Citi Bike built in, quiet-street and hill-aware routing, Lock Screen directions, widgets, Siri, achievements and city stats. Reads Been To and Fog of World and writes back to both.

versions.localizedDescription: Built for riding with the phone in your pocket and AirPods in. Plan a route, lock the phone and ride off: directions start on their own, the Lock Screen says Ready while it waits, and the screen goes dark in your pocket so nothing gets tapped by accident. Turn lines are timed to your real pace so they finish a few seconds before the corner, and they count streets when another one comes first ("take the second left") instead of saying "here". A tone in the left or right ear comes before each turn, a soft tick confirms you made it, and long stretches get a "stay on R Street for half a mile." "New street" is said when you cross into fog, not on every turn. Errands rides no longer drag you back after a missed turn: they head to your next stop from where you are, the way you're already going. If you ignore a few new routes in a row, it stops announcing them. No more freezes at every spoken line. Fill rides no longer make U-turns in the middle of a block. Every turn is listed on the route preview. All of it was stress-tested on simulated rides through all nine offline cities and replayed against your own ride logs.

Rebuilt from your ride logs. Directions now talk like Apple Maps does for bikes: "At the next light, turn right onto R Street," "After the light, turn left," "At the stop sign, turn left," "Take the second right," "Turn left into the alley, then turn right onto R Street." Miss a turn and Unfog plans fresh from where you are, the way you're already heading, instead of sending you back; anything you ride off-route counts right away and is never sent back to you. New Fastest option for going somewhere: the quickest route, with new streets only where they're nearly free, and it routes the moment you pick a place. Trips count turns and skip dead ends, so no more alley zig-zags. Turn prompts cut off anything older so they're never late. No more freezes during rides, and offline cities now install. Music dips under the voice and podcasts pause and pick back up; only directions interrupt what you're playing, and your audio is always handed back.

Directions that sound like a person: "left at the next light," "take the second right," "end of the street, go left," using traffic lights, stop signs and corner landmarks, rewritten on your iPhone by Apple Intelligence and checked against the route before they're spoken. Offline cities: DC, Baltimore, Wilmington, Philadelphia, New York, New Haven, Providence, Boston and Richmond download as one small file each, so plans start instantly and work without signal. Plans appear right away on streets already loaded, and your usual loop is ready before you tap Plan. Unfog learns your real pace from your rides. New option to clear fog on every walk and bike ride, even ones you don't start in the app.

A new look built around a pull-up panel. Directions say left, right and straight instead of compass points. Walks clear fog too. Capital Bikeshare and Citi Bike stations and loose e-bikes on the map, with advice on whether to dock or pay the lock-to fee near your destination, and a one-tap jump to the CaBi app to unlock. Routes can favor quiet streets and avoid hills. New planners: Frontier pushes out from the edge of your map, Errands strings stops together, Finish Lines lists the neighborhoods you're closest to completing. Lock Screen and Dynamic Island directions, Home Screen widgets, Siri shortcuts, rain warnings, offline street download, 18 tiered achievements and a Stats tab. Diagnostics logging so problems can be fixed from your rides.

Explored ground now glows mint and finished streets are drawn, with a legend. Streets load from a tiled cache so a second request no longer re-downloads everything, the map servers are asked in parallel, and fill-in plans on every core with a time cap. A new plan replaces one still in progress instead of getting stuck behind it. Unfog can write its Sync folder straight into iCloud Drive › beento › import.

Been To backups import correctly. Connect Been To's automatic backups folder to sync on every launch; hand-imported backups merge instead of replacing. New Sync folder at On My iPhone › Unfog › Fog of World › Sync for Been To to read.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Unfog plans rides from where you are and gives turn-by-turn directions, including with the screen locked in your pocket.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: With Always on, Unfog keeps giving directions and logging your ride when the phone is locked or another app is open.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Unfog uses motion to tell when you're walking or biking, so it can clear fog on outings you didn't start in the app. Driving and transit never count.
